issues.quote: پنج سند از نُه سند (۴۲۰۰۱، ۲۳۶۸۲، ۲۳۷۳۳، ۲۳۶۸۴ و ۲۳۶۸۱) در مراجع الزامی خود به ۲۳۶۷۹ ارجاع می‌دهند.
issues.explanation: The phrasing «پنج سند از نُه سند» is an exact count that implicitly asserts the remaining four documents (INSO 23728, 23683, 15816-3, and 23685) do NOT have 23679 in their normative references. Section 3's cited evidence confirms this only for 23685 (I23685-nr1 and I23685-nr2 list only 23683 and 13245 as normative references). For 23728 and 23683 the confirmation exists in I23728-ment and I23683-note respectively, but neither item appears in section 3's evidence list. For 15816-3, the source index shows that section H 2 (مراجع الزامی) exists but no evidence item — in section 3 or in section 0 — records the content of that normative-references clause, so the implicit claim that 15816-3 does not reference 23679 is entirely unsupported.
issues.suggested_fix: Either (a) add I23728-ment and I23683-note to section 3's evidence list and add an analogous evidence item transcribed from INSO 15816-3 §2 confirming that 23679 is not listed there; or (b) qualify the count: «پنج سند از نُه سند — بر اساس مراجع الزامی مندرج در متن هر سند (INSO 23728 و INSO 23683 فاقد هرگونه مرجع الزامی هستند؛ مراجع الزامی INSO 15816-3 شامل 23679 نمی‌شود) —». Do not leave the bare count «پنج سند از نُه سند» unsupported for three of the four implied non-referencers.
